CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for **Flint**, a local-first personal AI skills asset manager.
Flint centralizes the skill directories used by your AI agents so you can collect, tag, deduplicate and distribute `SKILL.md` skills from one local web UI — with no cloud account and no telemetry. Skills remain plain files on your own disk.
This repository ships the Docker template plus icon and documentation. It installs the upstream [`flint-skills-hub`](https://github.com/lcy362/flint) npm package on first start.
Support: please use the upstream issue tracker at https://github.com/lcy362/flint/issues and include your Unraid version and container logs (`docker logs flint`) when reporting template problems.
